name: Bharat Electronics Ltd.
business_summary: Navratna defence-electronics PSU (51.1% government) producing radars, communication and EW systems, naval sonars/combat systems, missile electronics, electro-optics, air-defence and homeland security solutions, with a small civil segment (railways, EVMs, medical). FY26 sales Rs27,610 cr (+16%), TTM Rs30,253 cr (+20%), EBITDA margin 28%, PAT Rs6,401 cr. Q2 FY27: sales Rs7,328 cr, PAT Rs1,541 cr (+20%), margin contracted; order book Rs68,717 cr. Market cap Rs289,796 cr at 45x P/E; ROE 27%; debtor days 170. Nifty 50 member since Aug 2026.

revenue_mix.segment: defence electronics (radars, EW, naval, air defence, comms)

exposures.mechanism: ~90% defence revenue; order book Rs68,717 cr (Q2 FY27, ~2.3x TTM sales Rs30,253 cr). +10% domestic orders => ~+8% revenue (some civil), op. leverage 1.3x => EBITDA +10%; EV/MCap ~0.96, persistence 0.6 => ~+5.8, shaded to 5.5. DAC cleared Rs2.12 lakh cr on 2026-10-26/27 (Rs13 lakh cr approvals cited by Motilal 2026-10-05).

evidence.note: Upstox/ET: defence stocks rally as Centre clears Rs2.12 lakh crore proposals
Upstox: Q2 PAT +20%, order book Rs68,717 cr

exposures.mechanism: Escalation boosts emergency orders for radars, EW and air-defence electronics; sentiment effect larger than earnings in 3 months (precedent May 2025, model knowledge).
Exports are ~5-10% of revenue (model knowledge); a +1 SSU step-up in exports (e.g. Akash, radars, naval systems) adds ~+3% revenue => ~+2.
Capital outlay for defence and Kavach/railway electronics underpins order flow; shaded because P_DEFENCE_PROCUREMENT already carries most of it.

Import content in electronics (~25-35% of material, model knowledge; material ~55% of sales). Supply tightening raises component prices/lead times: +1 SSU => cost +3% of material = 1.7% of sales vs 28% margin => -6% EBITDA, partial pass-through, persistence 0.5 => ~-1.5.
Imports ~13% of sales (assumed); +3% USD/INR => +0.4% of sales cost => -1.4% EBITDA, mostly hedged and partially passed through, small export offset; x0.96 x0.5 => ~-0.5.

Net cash firm (interest Rs7 cr TTM) with substantial treasury income; discount-rate effect on 45x P/E dominates, offset partly by deposit yields. RBI repo 5.50% from 2026-10-07. Receivable days 170 raise sensitivity to government payment delays.

evidence.note: Google News: Reuters 2026-10-07 'India first hike in nearly 4 years'; SCC Online 'repo to 5.50%, calibrated tightening'

exposures.mechanism: Nifty 50 constituent since Aug 2026 (replaced Wipro, NiftyTrader 2026-08-11) with FIIs trimming 19.5% to 17.0%; beta 1.4-1.5; empirical +0.2 sign-neutral, treated as noise.
+US$5bn quarterly FPI inflow lifts large-cap PSU defence beta stocks ~1.2 (beta 1.4); FII share fell 3.3pp since Mar 2026, so flows are a live marginal driver.
Small exposure via railway electronics (Kavach, signalling); revenue share ~3% => +10% => +0.3.

supply_chain.note: Dominant customer (>80% revenue, model knowledge); orders: Rs770 cr radar (2026-10-22), Rs533 cr (2026-10-13), Rs648 cr (2026-09-17)
Both defence PSUs share the MoD wallet; co-operation on missiles electronics
BEL supplies avionics and radar to HAL platforms (model knowledge)
